questions.section: PART TWO: STRUCTURED QUESTIONS (60 MARKS)
questions.question: 2. Demonstrate the difference between the terms Hub and Switch. ( 4marks)
questions.answer_guide:
Hub: a simple device that receives data and broadcasts it to all connected ports; it cannot read addresses, works at the physical layer and causes more collisions and slower networks.
Switch: an intelligent device that reads the destination MAC address and sends data only to the intended device; it works at the data-link layer, reduces collisions and is faster and more secure.

questions.question: 5. Illustrate the concept of Artificial Intelligence (AI). ( 4 marks)
questions.answer_guide: AI is the ability of computers/machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning, problem-solving, understanding language and recognising images. questions.question: 7. Describe how to open Microsoft Access 2016? (4 marks)
questions.answer_guide: Click the Start button → All apps → Access 2016 (or type “Access” in the search box and click it). Then choose Blank desktop database or open an existing database.

questions.section: PART TWO: STRUCTURED QUESTIONS (60 MARKS)
questions.question: 8. Compare the advantages and disadvantages of document review in system analysis and design? (4marks)
questions.answer_guide:
Advantages: gives information on how the current system works; cheap and quick; does not disturb staff; provides accurate written records.
Disadvantages: documents may be outdated, incomplete or inaccurate; time-consuming if there are many documents; does not show staff opinions or problems not written down.

questions.section: PART TWO: STRUCTURED QUESTIONS (60 MARKS)
questions.question: 9. Describe how to save the Current Record?(4 marks)
questions.answer_guide: In Access, select the Home tab, locate the Records group and click the Save command (or press Shift + Enter). Access also saves a record automatically when you move to another record.

questions.section: PART TWO: STRUCTURED QUESTIONS (60 MARKS)
questions.question: 10. What are Queries? ( 4 marks)
questions.answer_guide: A query is a database object used to search, retrieve, filter, sort and calculate data from one or more tables according to specified criteria – a question asked of the database.

questions.section: PART TWO: STRUCTURED QUESTIONS (60 MARKS)
questions.question: 11. List any three characteristics of a good primary key? (4 marks )
questions.answer_guide: Any three: it uniquely identifies each record; it is never empty (not null); its values rarely or never change; it is short and simple; each table has only one primary key.

questions.section: PART TWO: STRUCTURED QUESTIONS (60 MARKS)
questions.question: 12. What happens if you try to perform an operation on a variable and you have NOT assigned a value to it? (4 marks)
questions.answer_guide: The program produces an error – e.g. in Python a NameError (“name is not defined”) and the program stops; in some languages the variable contains a garbage/undefined value and gives wrong results.

questions.section: PART TWO: STRUCTURED QUESTIONS (60 MARKS)
questions.question: 14. Define the term digital security risks? ( 4 marks)
questions.answer_guide: A digital security risk is any event or action that could cause loss of or damage to computer hardware, software, data, information or processing capability – e.g. viruses/malware, hacking, software and information theft, hardware theft and system failure.
